_comment: Ability cards. 'params' are level-1 values; 'growth' lists params that scale by +growth_rate per upgrade level. Targets: none | enemy | area | path | defender. 'role' (damage, aoe, control, defense, run_stop, economy, buff or boss) says what the card is for; the deck builder reads it.

cards.name: Heat Wave
cards.text: Line of fire: {damage} damage, then burns runners.
cards.details: A roaring line of fire from the caster toward the target. Burns runners for {burn_dps}/s. Curved runners take +50% fire damage.
cards.art: A baseball wreathed in roaring flame streaking forward, leaving a wave of fire across infield dirt.

cards.name: Power Throw
cards.text: Hit one runner for {damage} and knock it back.
cards.details: The nearest defender rifles a fastball at one runner for {damage} damage and knocks it back.
cards.art: A white baseball with red stitches rocketing forward with motion streaks and a shockwave ring.

cards.name: Splitter
cards.text: {balls} balls hit runners in the area for {damage} each.
cards.details: A pitch that splits mid-air into {balls} seeking balls, each dealing {damage} to runners in the area.
cards.art: One baseball splitting into five glowing baseballs fanning out in arcs.

cards.name: Grand Slam Barrage
cards.text: {balls} flaming balls rain down: {damage} each + stun.
cards.details: A storm of {balls} blazing baseballs rains on the area, each dealing {damage} and stunning briefly.
cards.art: Dozens of flaming baseballs raining from a dramatic sunset sky onto a stadium like meteors.

cards.name: Grand Relay
cards.text: Team relay throw hits {targets} runners for {damage}+.
cards.details: A relay through the whole team: +20% power per defender, then the ball strikes up to {targets} runners for {damage}+.
cards.art: A golden baseball zig-zagging between glowing relay points, a chain of light gaining power.

cards.name: Power Catch
cards.text: Slam an area: {damage} damage, stun and break armor.
cards.details: Leap and slam: {damage} damage, stuns for {stun}s and shatters armor for {armor_break}s.
cards.art: A giant baseball glove slamming into the ground, cracked earth and purple shockwave.

cards.name: Thunderbolt
cards.text: Lightning: {damage} damage, jumps to {chains} more runners.
cards.details: A lightning fastball for {damage} that arcs to {chains} more runners.
cards.art: An electric yellow baseball crackling with forked lightning bolts.

cards.name: Curveball
cards.text: Slow runners 40% for {duration}s. They take +25% damage.
cards.details: Slows runners by 40% and marks them for {duration}s. Marked runners take +25% damage (+50% from fire).
cards.art: A baseball bending along a sweeping blue curved trail with spin lines.

cards.name: Knuckleball
cards.text: Confuse a runner for {confuse}s so it runs backwards.
cards.details: Confuses a runner for {confuse}s, sending it back the way it came. (Bosses are immune.)
cards.art: A wobbling baseball with question marks and a dizzy spiral trail.

cards.name: Shadow Change
cards.text: Push runners in the area back {pushback}m.
cards.details: A shadowy change-up drags runners back {pushback}m along their route and slows them.
cards.art: A dark purple baseball dissolving into shadow smoke with ghostly hands pulling backward.

cards.name: Time Out
cards.text: Freeze every runner for {freeze}s.
cards.details: The umpire calls time! All runners freeze for {freeze}s (bosses {boss_freeze}s). Defenders keep throwing.
cards.art: A giant stopwatch frozen in ice over a stadium, a referee whistle and a T hand sign.

cards.name: Changeup
cards.text: Slow every runner by 20% for {duration}s.
cards.details: Throws off everyone's timing: all runners are slowed by 20% for {duration}s.
cards.art: A slow-motion baseball with a clock-hand trail and ripples in the air.

cards.name: Pickoff
cards.text: Out a hurt runner (under 35% health). Else {damage} damage.
cards.details: Instantly outs a non-boss runner below 35% health. Otherwise deals {damage} damage.
cards.art: A teal-gloved hand slapping a tag on a sliding runner's boot at a base, motion lines.

cards.name: Lockdown
cards.text: Lock runners in place for {root}s.
cards.details: Roots runners for {root}s, then slows them. Lasts {home_bonus}s longer near home plate.
cards.art: Blue energy chains and a padlock wrapped around home plate, a catcher's mitt behind.

cards.name: Frost Field
cards.text: Ice the area for {duration}s: runners 50% slower.
cards.details: Freezes the turf for {duration}s: runners slow by 50% and throws gain +30% crit chance against them.
cards.art: Infield turf freezing over with jagged ice crystals and a frosted baseball.

cards.name: Wall of Dirt
cards.text: Block a path with a wall for {duration}s.
cards.details: Raises an earthen wall across a basepath that blocks runners for {duration}s or until it takes {hp} hits of damage.
cards.art: A wall of packed infield dirt erupting from the ground across a white chalk baseline.

cards.name: Base Shield
cards.text: Home plate blocks the next run.
cards.details: Shields home plate. The next runner to reach home is thrown out instead of scoring. (Max 3 shields.)
cards.art: A glowing hexagonal energy dome over home plate.

cards.name: Bunt Trap
cards.text: Trap a path: stops the next {charges} runners.
cards.details: Lays a sticky trap on a basepath that roots the next {charges} runners for {root}s and deals {damage} damage.
cards.art: A sticky glowing net trap laid on a basepath with a bunted ball resting in it.

cards.name: Diving Catch
cards.text: Dive in: {damage} damage, knock back and stun.
cards.details: A full-extension dive: {damage} damage, knocks runners back {knockback}m and stuns them.
cards.art: A pink-trimmed glove at full stretch snagging a ball in mid-air above the grass.

cards.name: Twin Play
cards.text: For {duration}s every throw bounces to a 2nd runner.
cards.details: For {duration}s every throw ricochets to a second runner for 70% damage. Chains also add +1 bounce to relays and lightning.
cards.art: Two baseballs orbiting each other with green motion trails, a double-play arrow.

cards.name: Field Vision
cards.text: Defenders +25% range for {duration}s. Reveals tricksters.
cards.details: Defenders gain +25% range for {duration}s, and Tricksters and decoys are revealed (cannot dodge).
cards.art: A glowing eye with a baseball iris over a tactical map of the diamond.

cards.name: Diamond Aura
cards.text: Aura on a defender: nearby allies +40% damage.
cards.details: A defender radiates a diamond aura for {duration}s: allies within {radius}m deal +40% damage and throw 25% faster.
cards.art: A radiant blue-white diamond gem with beams of light over a baseball diamond.

cards.name: Rally Cry
cards.text: All defenders throw 30% faster for {duration}s.
cards.details: The dugout roars! All defenders shake off stuns and throw 30% faster for {duration}s.
cards.art: A megaphone blasting a golden shockwave with a cheering crowd silhouette.

cards.name: Magnet Glove
cards.text: Pull runners in the area together and hold them.
cards.details: Drags runners in the area to its center and holds them for {pull_time}s. Combos with area cards.
cards.art: A baseball glove crackling with magnetic field lines pulling baseballs in.

cards.name: Sky Hook
cards.text: Hit the runner nearest home for {damage}, pull it back.
cards.details: A sky-high hook throw hits the runner closest to home for {damage} and yanks it back {pull}m.
cards.art: A baseball arcing high into a twilight sky trailing cyan light, curving down like a hook.

cards.name: Called Shot
cards.text: Lock on, then crush one runner: {damage} + {percent}% of its max health.
cards.details: Point to the stands and call it: after a short lock-on, a ball drops from the sky onto one runner for {damage} damage plus {percent}% of its max health (at most {max_bonus} extra on regular runners), ignoring armor. Bosses take the full share and are slowed by {slow}% for {slow_time}s.
cards.art: A huge golden reticle locked onto a baseball plunging from the sky, a hand pointing to the stands.

cards.name: Line Drive
cards.text: A screaming liner bursts on impact: {damage} to runners nearby.
cards.details: The nearest defender rips a flat line drive at the spot. It bursts on impact, hitting every runner in a small circle for {damage} damage and knocking them back a step.
cards.art: A baseball rocketing flat and straight with a white streak, bursting in a comic impact star.

cards.name: Tag at the Plate
cards.text: For {duration}s, the next runner to reach home is tagged out.
cards.details: The catcher blocks the plate for {duration}s. The next runner that reaches home is tagged out instead of scoring. A boss can't be tagged: it is stunned for {boss_stun}s and shoved {knockback}m back instead. One tag per card; it is used before Base Shields.
cards.art: A catcher's mitt slapping a tag down on home plate in a burst of dust and light.

cards.name: Bullpen Call
cards.text: Draw {draw} cards and gain {energy} energy.
cards.details: Call in a fresh arm: draw {draw} cards and gain {energy} energy. A cheap way to dig for the card you need.
cards.art: A bullpen telephone ringing with green light, two cards flying out of it.

cards.name: Hot Corner
cards.text: One defender's throws pierce armor, never miss, +{damage_bonus}% damage.
cards.details: Heat up one defender for {duration}s: its throws ignore armor, can't be dodged and deal +{damage_bonus}% damage. The answer to Armored Runners, Tricksters and plated bosses.
cards.art: A third-baseman's glove glowing red-hot, a blazing ball punching through a steel plate.

cards.name: Perfect Game
cards.text: Stun every runner, {damage} damage, bosses lose {boss_percent}% health.
cards.details: The whole diamond lights up: every runner is struck for {damage} damage and stunned for {stun}s, and bosses lose {boss_percent}% of their max health. For {tag_time}s after, every runner that reaches home is tagged out (bosses are stunned and shoved back).
cards.art: A golden baseball diamond blazing with light from all four bases, a crown above home plate.

cards.name: Seventh-Inning Stretch
cards.text: Gain {energy} energy and draw {draw} cards.
cards.details: Take a breather: gain {energy} energy and draw {draw} cards.
cards.art: A stadium crowd stretching with arms raised under evening lights, popcorn and pennants.

cards.name: Bean Ball
cards.text: Plunk a runner: {damage}, stun, knock back. Fast runners take double.
cards.details: A high, hard one: the nearest defender drills one runner for {damage} damage, stuns it for {stun}s and knocks it back {knockback}m. Fast runners (Sprinters, Swarmers and anyone stealing) take double damage and fly back twice as far.
cards.art: A red-hot fastball smacking a batting helmet, dizzy stars and a comic POW burst.

cards.name: Around the Horn
cards.text: The ball whips around the bases: {damage} to the lead runner on each path.
cards.details: Around the horn! The ball zips third to second to first and strikes the lead runner on every base path, up to {targets} runners (spare throws go to the next runners), for {damage} damage and a {stun}s stun each.
cards.art: A baseball zipping around a glowing diamond, base to base, in a ribbon of light.

cards.name: Grand Salami
cards.text: A giant fireball rolls down a base path: {damage} to every runner, then fire.
cards.details: The grand salami: a giant flaming ball slams onto the base path and rolls back toward the gate for {length}m, flattening every runner in its way for {damage} damage and bowling them back {knockback}m. Its trail burns for {burn_time}s, setting runners on fire ({burn_dps}/s).
cards.art: A colossal flaming baseball rolling down a basepath, a wall of fire behind it.

cards.name: Rundown
cards.text: Trap a runner in a rundown: it runs back and forth for {duration}s.
cards.details: Caught between the bases! One runner is stuck in a rundown for {duration}s, running back and forth over a {span}m stretch and taking a {damage}-damage tag every time it turns. Bosses break out sooner (40% of the time).
cards.art: A runner caught between two glowing bases, arrows bouncing back and forth, a glove closing in.

cards.name: Rain Delay
cards.text: Rain delay: no new runners for {delay}s, every runner {slow}% slower.
cards.details: The tarp comes out. For {delay}s no new runners leave the gates, and every runner on the field slips along {slow}% slower. Bosses get the full slow. Your energy keeps flowing.
cards.art: A storm cloud pouring rain over a tarp-covered infield, puddles and a closed gate.

cards.name: Intentional Walk
cards.text: Walk a runner: {slow}% slower for {duration}s, and it can't score.
cards.details: Wave one runner on: for {duration}s it only walks ({slow}% slower), and if it reaches home while walking it scores no run. Bosses ignore it.
cards.art: An umpire's hand pointing to first base over four floating baseballs, BALL FOUR.

cards.name: Infield Fly
cards.text: A pop-up hangs over an area: the first runner in it is called out.
cards.details: Infield fly, the batter's out! A pop-up hangs over the area for {duration}s. The first runner in it is called out when the ball comes down {delay}s later. A boss can't be called out: it takes {boss_damage} damage and is stunned instead.
cards.art: A baseball hanging high in a spotlight over the infield, a glove waiting below.

cards.name: Golden Glove
cards.text: A defender catches the next {charges} runners that come near: out!
cards.details: Gild one defender's glove for {duration}s: the next {charges} runners that come within {radius}m are snagged and put out on the spot. A boss can't be caught: it takes {boss_damage} damage and a stun, and uses up a catch.
cards.art: A gleaming golden glove snatching a ball out of the air, sparkles and a trophy shine.

cards.name: The Shift
cards.text: Every defender shifts toward the spot for {duration}s and throws faster.
cards.details: Put on the shift: every defender slides up to {shift}m toward the spot for {duration}s, then jogs back to its post. Shifted defenders throw 25% faster.
cards.art: A diamond diagram with defender markers sliding along bold arrows toward one side.

cards.name: Momentum
cards.text: For {duration}s, every out gives {energy} energy.
cards.details: Ride the momentum: for {duration}s every runner put out gives you {energy} energy (up to {max_energy} energy in all).
cards.art: A baseball rolling downhill gathering speed, energy chevrons streaming behind it.

cards.name: Relief Pitcher
cards.text: A reliever jogs in and throws at runners for {duration}s.
cards.details: Call the bullpen: a relief pitcher jogs to the spot and fires at runners within {range}m for {duration}s, {damage} damage per throw every {interval}s. His throws can crit like a defender's. He heads back when time is up.
cards.art: A pitcher jogging out of a glowing bullpen gate, ball in hand, the bullpen door swung open.

cards.name: Instant Replay
cards.text: Replay the last card you played, free and {levels} level stronger.
cards.details: Let's go to the replay: the last card you played this game (not a Legendary) goes off again for free at the same target, {levels} level stronger. If its target is gone, it picks the runner nearest home. With nothing to replay, your energy comes back.
cards.art: A jumbotron showing a rewind symbol, a glowing replay of a ball arcing across the screen.
